availableCommands.name: context-gatherer
availableCommands.description: Investigates the codebase to answer a specific question about it. Deeply analyzes existing code by tracing execution paths, mapping architecture and abstraction layers, understanding patterns, and documenting dependencies, returning a thorough, direct written analysis that explains how the relevant code works and points to the specific files and lines involved. Use it to understand code before you change it: before designing or implementing a change to code you don't already fully understand, start with context-gatherer so your edits are grounded in how the code actually works. When a task requires understanding code you don't already know, dispatch context-gatherer to do that exploration before running your own searches or reads. Rules: 1. Provide a clear, specific prompt that includes your intent: a detailed task description of the context you need and what you're trying to accomplish. 2. The subagent explores the codebase and returns an analysis of your query 3. Trust the returned results. You may still inspect additional code yourself when you need context beyond what was returned. 4. Reuse existing context-gatherer output for related follow-up questions; do not re-invoke on the same question with different phrasing. 5. For multiple distinct questions, dispatch several context-gatherers in parallel, each targeting a different aspect of the codebase.

# Implementation Plan: ot-security-lab

Run the harness after every task from the repository root: `tools/dotnet run --project csharp/GhostWire.Tests/GhostWire.Tests.csproj`. A task is done only when the harness prints `All GhostWire protocol and HTTP checks passed.` No NuGet packages. No commits unless the owner asks.

- [ ] 1. Add the pure Modbus codec
  - Add `ModbusCodec`, `DecodedFrame`, `FrameField`, `ByteRange`, `Mbap` and `ParsedAdu` to `csharp/GhostWire/Modbus.cs`.
  - Implement encoders for FC03/FC04 requests and responses, FC06 request and echo response, and exception responses, with argument validation.
  - Implement `Decode` / `TryParse` that never throw, walk fields in byte order, name register fields by absolute offset when the request address is known, and set `decode_error` at the first failure.
  - Implement `Hex` (uppercase, space-separated).
  - Add example checks: the Giant Pressure request and response bytes from `modbus-protocol.md` decode to the expected fields; `84 02` decodes as exception 02.
  - _Requirements: 1.4, 1.6, 1.7_

- [ ] 2. Add the property-based test runner and codec properties
- [ ] 2.1 Add the seeded generator and runner to the harness
  - Implement SplitMix64 `Rng` with `NextInt`, `NextBytes`, `Pick`.
  - Implement `Property(name, cases, body)`: fixed default seed, `GHOSTWIRE_PBT_SEED` override, `PBT seed: <seed>` printed at start, per-property seed `baseSeed ^ FNV1a(name)`, failure message with property name, seed, case index and input, elapsed time per property.
  - _Requirements: 4.1, 4.2, 4.3_
- [ ] 2.2 Property P-a: codec round-trip for FC03, FC04 and FC06 requests, responses and exceptions (≥200 cases)
  - _Requirements: 4.3, 4.4, 1.6_
- [ ] 2.3 Property P-b: decoder never throws on random byte arrays of length 0–300, in both directions (≥200 cases)
  - _Requirements: 4.3, 4.5, 1.7_

- [ ] 3. Capture wire bytes on the client and the simulator
- [ ] 3.1 Return exchanged bytes from `ModbusClient`
  - Add `ModbusExchange(Sent, Received)` to `ModbusResult`; set `Sent` only after the write completes; accumulate `Received` from the header and PDU reads.
  - Build the request with `ModbusCodec.EncodeReadRequest`.
  - Throw `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` before opening a socket when the function is not 3 or 4.
  - Add checks: a function-6 call throws and the simulator sees no exchange.
  - _Requirements: 1.3, 1.5, 5.3_
- [ ] 3.2 Add `IExchangeRecorder` and the `allowWrites` option to `ModbusSimulator`
  - Record `(RemotePort, Received, Sent)` once per handled request; swallow recorder exceptions.
  - With `allowWrites: false` (default), FC06 still returns exception 01. With `allowWrites: true`, FC06 writes an existing holding register under a lock and echoes the request PDU; a missing address returns exception 02.
  - Keep the existing raw TCP check "writes must be rejected" unchanged.
  - _Requirements: 5.2, 5.4, 2.2_

- [ ] 4. Add `frames` to `/api/test` results
  - Build frames from `ModbusResult.Exchange` with `ModbusCodec.Decode`: request plus response when bytes were received, request only on timeout, empty when nothing was sent.
  - Add `frames` to the result before calling `ExplainAsync`.
  - Add checks: Giant Pressure request and response hex match the documented example; Silent Sensor initial read has exactly one request frame; Wrong Register response decodes exception 02.
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 5.6, 7.2_
- [ ] 4.1 Property P-e: frames hex equals the bytes the simulator recorded as received and sent (≥200 cases)
  - Use a harness simulator with a recorder and the same frame-building function as `TrainingService`.
  - _Requirements: 4.3, 4.8, 1.5_
- [ ] 4.2 Property P-c: for random valid reads, status is exactly one of response, exception or timeout, and response register count equals quantity (≥200 cases, batches of 8)
  - _Requirements: 4.3, 4.6_

- [ ] 5. Extract the diagnosis rules into a pure `Diagnosis` class
  - Move observations, causes, hints, next steps and `verified` from `TrainingService.TestAsync` into `Diagnosis.ForRead` with identical text for the three existing cases.
  - Confirm all existing case checks still pass with unchanged `status`, `raw_registers`, `engineering_value`, `unit` and `verified`.
  - _Requirements: 7.2, 7.3, 7.4_
- [ ] 5.1 Property P-d: a timeout diagnosis never claims a single certain cause, for all scenarios and random requests (≥200 cases)

<content>
# Requirements Document: ot-security-lab

## Introduction

This feature extends GhostWire from a three-case Modbus troubleshooting lab into an OT security and troubleshooting lab. It adds:

- a frame inspector that shows the actual Modbus TCP bytes of every simulated read;
- a defensive incident case, **Phantom Writer**, in which the learner finds an unauthorized FC06 write in a simulated captured traffic log;
- case categories and difficulty;
- property-based tests in the existing dependency-free harness;
- updated judge documentation for all four cases.

The existing cases (The Giant Pressure, The Silent Sensor, The Wrong Register) keep their behavior. Existing API fields keep their names, types and meaning. Every value shown to a learner comes from a simulator run on loopback. Nothing in this feature connects to physical equipment, lets a learner send a Modbus write, or claims anything about a real installation.

The steering files `.kiro/steering/{product,safety,tech,modbus-protocol,accessibility}.md` apply to every requirement below.

## Glossary

- **ADU**: Modbus TCP application data unit. The 7-byte MBAP header followed by the PDU.
- **MBAP header**: Modbus Application Protocol header: transaction ID (2 bytes), protocol ID (2), length (2), unit ID (1).
- **PDU**: Protocol data unit. Function code (1 byte) followed by function-specific data.
- **FC03 / FC04 / FC06**: Read Holding Registers / Read Input Registers / Write Single Register.
- **Frame**: The exact bytes of one ADU sent or received on a loopback TCP connection.
- **Frame inspector**: The "Wire evidence" panel and the `frames` field that expose frames and their decoded fields.
- **Learner read path**: `POST /api/test` and the `ModbusClient` code it calls.
- **Incident generator**: Server-side startup code that performs the scripted Phantom Writer exchanges against its own private simulator and records them.
- **Traffic log**: The simulated captured traffic produced by the incident generator.
- **Client label**: A simulated name (for example `HMI-01`) that the incident generator assigns to each of its own TCP connections. Modbus TCP frames carry no client identity; the label is capture metadata.
- **Evidence categories**: `observations`, `possible_causes`, `training_hints`, `next_steps`, `verified`.
- **Property**: A statement that must hold for every generated input in a property-based test.

## Requirements

### Requirement 1: Frame inspector

**User Story:** As a learner, I want to see the exact Modbus TCP bytes of each simulated read and what each byte means, so that I can check my request and the device's reply from wire evidence instead of from a summary.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN `POST /api/test` completes with status `response`, `exception` or `error`, THE SYSTEM SHALL include a `frames` array in the result containing one request frame and, if any response bytes were received, one response frame.
2. WHEN `POST /api/test` completes with status `timeout`, THE SYSTEM SHALL include only the request frame in `frames`.
3. IF the request bytes were not fully written to the socket (for example the loopback connection failed), THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL return an empty `frames` array and SHALL NOT show a request frame that was never transmitted.
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL represent each frame as `{ "direction": "request" | "response", "hex": string, "fields": [ { "name", "value", "bytes" } ], "decode_error": string | null }`, where `hex` is the uppercase, space-separated hexadecimal form of the bytes and `bytes` is `{ "offset": int, "length": int }` into that frame.
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL build `hex` from the byte arrays actually written to and read from the loopback socket, not by re-encoding the request settings.
6. WHEN a frame is decoded, THE SYSTEM SHALL list these fields in byte order: transaction ID, protocol ID, length, unit ID, function code, then for an FC03/FC04 request the start address and quantity; for an FC03/FC04 response the byte count and one field per register value; for an FC06 request or response the register address and register value; for an exception response the exception code.
7. IF a response frame cannot be fully decoded (wrong protocol ID, length outside 2–254, byte count mismatch or truncated data), THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL return the fields decoded so far and a non-null `decode_error` describing the first failure, and SHALL NOT throw.
8. WHEN a result is rendered, THE SYSTEM SHALL show the frames in a collapsible panel titled "Wire evidence", collapsed by default, labeled as simulated.
9. THE SYSTEM SHALL render each frame as a `<table>` with header cells for field name, bytes (hex, monospace) and decoded value, and SHALL define MBAP, PDU, unit ID and function code in plain language the first time the panel shows them.
10. WHEN a learner hovers over or moves keyboard focus to a field row, THE SYSTEM SHALL highlight the matching bytes in the frame's hex display and SHALL indicate the link in text (byte offset and length), not by color alone.
11. THE SYSTEM SHALL make the panel and every field row reachable and operable with the keyboard alone, and SHALL respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

### Requirement 2: Phantom Writer incident case

**User Story:** As a learner, I want to investigate a simulated unauthorized setpoint change from a captured traffic log, so that I can practice identifying a Modbus write from evidence and learn which real-world controls reduce that risk.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a scenario with id `phantom-writer`, title "Phantom Writer" and category `security`, whose simulated device is a boiler controller at unit ID 5 with holding register offset 100 holding the temperature setpoint at 0.1 °C per count, documented normal value 650 (65.0 °C).
2. WHEN the server starts, THE SYSTEM SHALL generate the traffic log by performing real Modbus TCP exchanges over loopback between the incident generator and a private, write-enabled simulator that no HTTP endpoint can reach.
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL produce a traffic log of 12 transactions: 11 FC03 reads of holding register 100 from client label `HMI-01`, and one FC06 write of value 950 to register 100 from a different client label, at a fixed position in the sequence.
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL make the traffic log deterministic: client labels, transaction IDs, simulated timestamps, request bytes and response bytes SHALL be identical on every server start.
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL record each traffic log entry's request and response bytes from what the private simulator actually received and sent, and SHALL decode them with the same decoder as the frame inspector.
6. IF the captured exchanges differ from the incident script (missing transaction, unexpected status, or final register value other than 950), THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL fail startup with an error rather than serve a partial or invented log.
7. WHEN traffic log generation finishes, THE SYSTEM SHALL dispose the private write-enabled simulator and SHALL serve learner reads for `phantom-writer` from a separate read-only simulator whose register 100 holds the final value observed in the captured log.
8. WHEN a learner reads unit 5, FC03, address 100, quantity 1 with scale 0.1 through `POST /api/test`, THE SYSTEM SHALL return raw register 950 and engineering value 95.0 with `unit: "°C"`.
9. WHEN the learner opens the traffic log, THE SYSTEM SHALL return it from `GET /api/incident/phantom-writer/log` with, per entry: sequence number, simulated time, client label, transaction ID, unit ID, function code and name, decoded address and value(s), and the request and response frames in the Requirement 1 format.
10. THE SYSTEM SHALL label the traffic log as a simulated capture and SHALL state that Modbus TCP frames carry no client identity and the client label is capture metadata.
11. WHEN `POST /api/incident/answer` receives exactly `scenario_id`, `transaction_id` and `client`, THE SYSTEM SHALL return `verified: true` only if both the transaction ID and the client label match the unauthorized write.
12. WHEN the answer is verified, THE SYSTEM SHALL return observations that cite the evidence from the captured log (function code 06, unit ID, register address 100, old value 650, new value 950, simulated time and client label) and a `mitigations` list labeled as real-world guidance not verified by this simulation, covering: network segmentation into IEC 62443 zones and conduits, allow-listing write function codes on a gateway or industrial firewall, Modbus/TCP Security (TLS with certificate-based roles), and change logging with review.
13. IF the answer is not verified, THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL return `verified: false`, an empty `mitigations` list and an observation describing what the captured log shows for the submitted transaction ID (or that no such transaction exists), and SHALL NOT reveal the correct pair.
14. IF the answer payload has missing, extra or duplicate fields, a `scenario_id` that is not a security case, a `transaction_id` outside 0–65535, or a `client` that is not 1–32 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL return HTTP 400 with `{ "error": "..." }`.
15. WHEN a learner views the traffic log before a verified answer, THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT mark any row as suspicious; WHEN the answer is verified, THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the offending row with the text "Unauthorized write" and an icon in addition to color, and the row SHALL be reachable by keyboard.

### Requirement 3: Categories, difficulty and case picker

**User Story:** As a learner, I want cases grouped by type and marked with difficulty, so that I can tell troubleshooting exercises from security investigations and choose where to start.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL include `category` (`"troubleshooting"` or `"security"`) and `difficulty` (`"beginner"` or `"intermediate"`) in every entry returned by `GET /api/scenarios`.
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL assign category `troubleshooting` to `pressure-scaling`, `unit-id` and `register-addressing`, and category `security` to `phantom-writer`.
3. WHEN the case picker is rendered, THE SYSTEM SHALL group scenarios by category using labeled groups ("Troubleshooting", "Security incidents") and SHALL show each case's difficulty as text.
4. WHEN a `security` case is selected, THE SYSTEM SHALL show the traffic log panel and the answer form; WHEN a `troubleshooting` case is selected, THE SYSTEM SHALL hide them.

### Requirement 4: Property-based tests

**User Story:** As a maintainer, I want property-based tests for the codec, the transport and the diagnosis rules, so that edge cases are checked across many generated inputs and any failure can be reproduced.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL implement property-based tests inside `csharp/GhostWire.Tests/Program.cs` (or files in that project) with no NuGet package, using a small seeded pseudo-random generator implemented in the harness.
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL print the base seed before running properties, SHALL accept an override through the `GHOSTWIRE_PBT_SEED` environment variable, and WHEN a property fails SHALL print the property name, the seed, the case index and the failing input before exiting non-zero.
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL run each property for at least 200 generated cases.
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL check property (a): for random valid inputs, encoding then decoding FC03, FC04 and FC06 requests and responses (including exception responses) returns the original field values.
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL check property (b): for random byte arrays of length 0–300, the decoder returns a result with either no `decode_error` or a non-null `decode_error`, and never throws.
6. THE SYSTEM SHALL check property (c): for random valid read requests against a loopback simulator, the status is exactly one of `response`, `exception` or `timeout`, and for `response` the number of returned registers equals the requested quantity.
7. THE SYSTEM SHALL check property (d): for every scenario and random request with status `timeout`, the diagnosis returns `verified: false`, at least two possible causes, at least one cause that does not mention the unit ID, and no statement asserting a single certain cause.
8. THE SYSTEM SHALL check property (e): for random valid read requests, the `frames` hex equals the bytes the simulator recorded as received (request) and sent (response).
9. WHEN all checks pass, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep printing `All GhostWire protocol and HTTP checks passed.`.

### Requirement 5: Safety boundaries

**User Story:** As the project owner, I want the new features to keep every existing safety boundary, so that the lab stays a loopback-only, read-only training tool.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT accept a host, port or URL in any request field, query string or path segment of any endpoint.
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL bind the HTTP server and every simulator, including the private incident simulator, to IPv4 loopback only.
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `POST /api/test` limited to function codes 3 and 4, and `ModbusClient` SHALL refuse to build or send any other function code.
4. IF FC06 is sent to any learner-reachable simulator, THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reply with exception code 01 and leave registers unchanged.
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL perform FC06 only in the incident generator at startup, only against its private simulator, and only with values from the fixed incident script.
6. WHEN an AI provider is configured, THE SYSTEM SHALL send it the structured evidence including `frames` (and, for answers, the evidence of the matched log entry), and THE SYSTEM SHALL compute `status`, `raw_registers`, `frames`, `verified` and `mitigations` before and independently of the provider call.
7. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the existing limits: 16 KiB request bodies, 120 requests per minute, 8 concurrent tests (shared by `POST /api/test` and `POST /api/incident/answer`), 300 ms Modbus deadline per exchange, and 4 s and 64 KiB for the AI provider.
8. THE SYSTEM SHALL apply the existing Host, Origin, loopback-peer, content-type and size checks to the new endpoints.

### Requirement 6: Documentation

**User Story:** As a judge, I want a quick start that walks through all four cases, so that I can evaluate the lab in a few minutes without hardware or an AI key.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL update the judge quick start in `README.md` and `docs/judge-quick-start.md` to cover The Giant Pressure, The Silent Sensor, The Wrong Register and Phantom Writer, including how to open Wire evidence.
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL document for Phantom Writer the initial read, opening the traffic log, the information the learner must identify, and the expected verified outcome, using only values produced by a simulator run.
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL update `csharp/README.md` with the `frames` field, `category`, `difficulty`, the incident log endpoint and the answer endpoint, including their validation rules.
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL state in the docs that the FC06 write happens only inside the server's private simulator at startup, that learners cannot send writes, and that mitigations are guidance not verified by the simulation.
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL update `docs/verification.md` with checks actually observed in a harness run, including the printed property seed.

### Requirement 7: Compatibility with existing cases

**User Story:** As an existing user of the three troubleshooting cases, I want them to behave as before, so that the current lessons, tests and screenshots stay valid.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the request schema of `POST /api/test` unchanged: exactly `scenario_id`, `unit_id`, `function_code`, `address`, `quantity` and `scale`, with the existing ranges.
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep every existing response field of `POST /api/test` and `GET /api/scenarios` with the same name, type and meaning; new fields SHALL be additive.
3. WHEN the existing initial and corrected requests for the three troubleshooting cases are sent, THE SYSTEM SHALL return the same `status`, `raw_registers`, `engineering_value`, `unit` and `verified` values as before this feature.
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the existing harness checks passing, updating only the scenario count check from 3 to 4.

</content>
</file>

8. THE SYSTEM SHALL check property (e): for random valid read requests, the `frames` hex equals the bytes the simulator recorded as received (request) and sent (response).
9. WHEN all checks pass, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep printing `All GhostWire protocol and HTTP checks passed.`.

### Requirement 5: Safety boundaries

**User Story:** As the project owner, I want the new features to keep every existing safety boundary, so that the lab stays a loopback-only, read-only training tool.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT accept a host, port or URL in any request field, query string or path segment of any endpoint.
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL bind the HTTP server and every simulator, including the private incident simulator, to IPv4 loopback only.
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `POST /api/test` limited to function codes 3 and 4, and `ModbusClient` SHALL refuse to build or send any other function code.
4. IF FC06 is sent to any learner-reachable simulator, THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reply with exception code 01 and leave registers unchanged.
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL perform FC06 only in the incident generator at startup, only against its private simulator, and only with values from the fixed incident script.
6. WHEN an AI provider is configured, THE SYSTEM SHALL send it the structured evidence including `frames` (and, for answers, the evidence of the matched log entry), and THE SYSTEM SHALL compute `status`, `raw_registers`, `frames`, `verified` and `mitigations` before and independently of the provider call.
7. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the existing limits: 16 KiB request bodies, 120 requests per minute, 8 concurrent tests (shared by `POST /api/test` and `POST /api/incident/answer`), 300 ms Modbus deadline per exchange, and 4 s and 64 KiB for the AI provider.
8. THE SYSTEM SHALL apply the existing Host, Origin, loopback-peer, content-type and size checks to the new endpoints.

### Requirement 6: Documentation

**User Story:** As a judge, I want a quick start that walks through all four cases, so that I can evaluate the lab in a few minutes without hardware or an AI key.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL update the judge quick start in `README.md` and `docs/judge-quick-start.md` to cover The Giant Pressure, The Silent Sensor, The Wrong Register and Phantom Writer, including how to open Wire evidence.
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL document for Phantom Writer the initial read, opening the traffic log, the information the learner must identify, and the expected verified outcome, using only values produced by a simulator run.
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL update `csharp/README.md` with the `frames` field, `category`, `difficulty`, the incident log endpoint and the answer endpoint, including their validation rules.
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL state in the docs that the FC06 write happens only inside the server's private simulator at startup, that learners cannot send writes, and that mitigations are guidance not verified by the simulation.
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL update `docs/verification.md` with checks actually observed in a harness run, including the printed property seed.

### Requirement 7: Compatibility with existing cases

**User Story:** As an existing user of the three troubleshooting cases, I want them to behave as before, so that the current lessons, tests and screenshots stay valid.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the request schema of `POST /api/test` unchanged: exactly `scenario_id`, `unit_id`, `function_code`, `address`, `quantity` and `scale`, with the existing ranges.
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep every existing response field of `POST /api/test` and `GET /api/scenarios` with the same name, type and meaning; new fields SHALL be additive.
3. WHEN the existing initial and corrected requests for the three troubleshooting cases are sent, THE SYSTEM SHALL return the same `status`, `raw_registers`, `engineering_value`, `unit` and `verified` values as before this feature.
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the existing harness checks passing, updating only the scenario count check from 3 to 4.

using System.Buffers.Binary;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;

namespace GhostWire;

public sealed class ModbusSimulator : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly TcpListener listener = new(IPAddress.Loopback, 0);
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource stopping = new();
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim slots = new(32);
    private readonly int unit;
    private readonly Dictionary<int, Dictionary<int, ushort>> registers;
    private readonly Task acceptLoop;
    public int Port => ((IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint).Port;

    public ModbusSimulator(int unit, Dictionary<int, Dictionary<int, ushort>> registers)
    {
        this.unit = unit;
        this.registers = registers;
        listener.Start();
        acceptLoop = AcceptAsync();
    }

    private async Task AcceptAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            while (!stopping.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                var client = await listener.AcceptTcpClientAsync(stopping.Token);
                if (!slots.Wait(0)) { client.Dispose(); continue; }
                _ = ServeAsync(client);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        catch (SocketException) when (stopping.IsCancellationRequested) { }
    }

    private async Task ServeAsync(TcpClient client)
    {
        try
        {
            using (client)
            using (var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(stopping.Token))
            {
                deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
                var stream = client.GetStream();
                var header = new byte[7];
                await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(header, deadline.Token);
                int protocol = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(2));
                int length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(4));
                if (protocol != 0 || length < 2 || length > 254) return;
                var pdu = new byte[length - 1];
                await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(pdu, deadline.Token);
                if (header[6] != unit) { await Task.Delay(600, deadline.Token); return; }
                int function = pdu[0];
                byte[] reply;
                if (function is not (3 or 4)) reply = new byte[] { (byte)(function | 0x80), 1 };
                else if (pdu.Length != 5) reply = new byte[] { (byte)(function | 0x80), 3 };
                else
                {
                    int address = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(1));
                    int quantity = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(3));
                    if (quantity is < 1 or > 125) reply = new byte[] { (byte)(function | 0x80), 3 };
                    else if (address + quantity > 65536 || !registers.TryGetValue(function, out var map) || Enumerable.Range(address, quantity).Any(i => !map.ContainsKey(i)))
                        reply = new byte[] { (byte)(function | 0x80), 2 };
                    else
                    {
                        reply = new byte[2 + 2 * quantity];
                        reply[0] = (byte)function; reply[1] = (byte)(2 * quantity);
                        for (int i = 0; i < quantity; i++) BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(reply.AsSpan(2 + 2 * i), map[address + i]);
                    }
                }
                BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(4), (ushort)(reply.Length + 1));
                await stream.WriteAsync(header, deadline.Token);
                await stream.WriteAsync(reply, deadline.Token);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or SocketException or OperationCanceledException or ObjectDisposedException) { }
        finally { slots.Release(); }
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        stopping.Cancel();
        listener.Stop();
        await acceptLoop;
        // In-flight handlers own their sockets and observe the cancellation token.
    }
}

public sealed record ModbusResult(string Status, ushort[] Values, int? ExceptionCode);

public static class ModbusClient
{
    public static async Task<ModbusResult> ReadAsync(int port, int unit, int function, int address, int quantity, CancellationToken=<redacted>    {
        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(300));
        try
        {
            using var client = new TcpClient();
            await client.ConnectAsync(IPAddress.Loopback, port, deadline.Token);
            using var stream = client.GetStream();
            var request = new byte[12] { 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 6, (byte)unit, (byte)function, 0, 0, 0, 0 };
            BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(request.AsSpan(8), (ushort)address);
            BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(request.AsSpan(10), (ushort)quantity);
            await stream.WriteAsync(request, deadline.Token);
            var header = new byte[7];
            await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(header, deadline.Token);
            int length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(4));
            if (BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header) != 1 || BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(2)) != 0 || header[6] != unit || length < 2 || length > 254)
                return new("error", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null);
            var pdu = new byte[length - 1];
            await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(pdu, deadline.Token);
            if (pdu.Length == 2 && pdu[0] == (function | 0x80)) return new("exception", Array.Empty<ushort>(), pdu[1]);
            if (pdu.Length != 2 + quantity * 2 || pdu[0] != function || pdu[1] != quantity * 2) return new("error", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null);
            var values = new ushort[quantity];
            for (int i = 0; i < quantity; i++) values[i] = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(2 + 2 * i));
            return new("response", values, null);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) { return new("timeout", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null); }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or SocketException) { return new("error", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null); }
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace GhostWire;

public sealed record Setup(int unit_id, int function_code, int address, int quantity, double scale);
public sealed record TestRequest(string scenario_id, int unit_id, int function_code, int address, int quantity, double scale);
public sealed record Scenario(string id, string title, string summary, Setup initial, string[] documentation, int unit, int function, int address, ushort value, double? requiredScale);

public sealed class TrainingService : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private static readonly Scenario[] Cases = {
        new("pressure-scaling", "The Giant Pressure", "A pressure reading responds, but its engineering value looks wrong.", new(7,3,10,1,1), new[] { "Simulated device: unit 7, holding register offset 10.", "The simulated pressure register uses a multiplier of 0.01 bar per count." }, 7,3,10,39,0.01),
        new("unit-id", "The Silent Sensor", "A read times out despite a running simulated gateway.", new(1,4,0,1,1), new[] { "Simulated gateway routes this device at unit 17.", "The simulated device publishes its value at input register offset 0.", "In this simulation only, a unit mismatch is silently ignored." }, 17,4,0,73,null),
        new("register-addressing", "The Wrong Register", "The device responds with an illegal data address exception.", new(3,4,21,1,1), new[] { "Simulated device: unit 3, input register offset 20.", "This exercise uses zero-based protocol offsets, not one-based register labels." }, 3,4,20,125,null)
    };
    private readonly Dictionary<string, ModbusSimulator> simulators = new();
    private static readonly HttpClient Provider = new(new HttpClientHandler { AllowAutoRedirect = false }) { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(4) };

    public TrainingService()
    {
        try

using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using GhostWire;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.FileProviders;

var app = GhostWireHost.Create(args);
await app.RunAsync();

namespace GhostWire
{
    public static class GhostWireHost
    {
        public static WebApplication Create(string[] args, int? port = null)
        {
            int selectedPort = port ?? PortFromEnvironment();
            var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(new WebApplicationOptions { Args = args, ContentRootPath = AppContext.BaseDirectory });
            builder.WebHost.ConfigureKestrel(options =>
            {
                options.Listen(IPAddress.Loopback, selectedPort);
                options.Limits.MaxRequestBodySize = 16384;
                options.Limits.MaxConcurrentConnections = 64;
                options.Limits.RequestHeadersTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
            });
            builder.Services.AddSingleton<TrainingService>();
            builder.Services.AddRateLimiter(options =>
            {
                options.RejectionStatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;
                options.GlobalLimiter = PartitionedRateLimiter.Create<HttpContext, string>(context =>
                    RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter("local", _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
                    {
                        PermitLimit = 120, Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1), QueueLimit = 0, AutoReplenishment = true
                    }));
            });
            var app = builder.Build();
            var concurrentTests = new SemaphoreSlim(8);
            app.Use(async (context, next) =>
            {
                var host = context.Request.Host;
                bool validHost = (string.Equals(host.Host, "localhost", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || host.Host == "127.0.0.1") && host.Port == context.Connection.LocalPort;
                bool local = context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress != null && IPAddress.IsLoopback(context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress);
                if (!validHost || !local)
                {
                    context.Response.StatusCode = 403;
                    await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new { error = "Forbidden host" });
                    return;
                }
                if (context.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("Origin", out var origins))
                {
                    string expected = $"http://{host.Host}:{host.Port}";
                    if (origins.Count != 1 || !string.Equals(origins[0], expected, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        context.Response.StatusCode = 403;
                        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new { error = "Cross-origin requests are not allowed" });
                        return;
                    }
                }
                context.Response.Headers.XContentTypeOptions = "nosniff";
                if (context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/api")) context.Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-store";
                await next();
            });
            app.UseRateLimiter();
            app.MapGet("/api/scenarios", (TrainingService service) => Results.Json(service.Scenarios()));
            app.MapPost("/api/test", async (HttpContext context, TrainingService service) =>
            {
                if (!System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue.TryParse(context.Request.ContentType, out var type) || !string.Equals(type.MediaType, "application/json", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    return Results.Json(new { error = "Content-Type must be application/json" }, statusCode: 415);
                if (context.Request.ContentLength is 0 or > 16384) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                if (!await concurrentTests.WaitAsync(0, context.RequestAborted)) return Results.Json(new { error = "Too many concurrent tests" }, statusCode: 429);
                try
                {
                    using var buffer = new MemoryStream();
                    var bytes = new byte[4096];
                    while (true)
                    {
                        int count = await context.Request.Body.ReadAsync(bytes, context.RequestAborted);
                        if (count == 0) break;
                        if (buffer.Length + count > 16384) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                        buffer.Write(bytes, 0, count);
                    }
                    if (buffer.Length == 0) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                    using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(buffer.ToArray());
                    var request = TrainingService.Validate(document.RootElement);
                    return Results.Json(await service.TestAsync(request, context.RequestAborted));
                }
                catch (JsonException) { return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid JSON" }, statusCode: 400); }
                catch (ArgumentException ex) { return Results.Json(new { error = ex.Message }, statusCode: 400); }
                finally { concurrentTests.Release(); }
            });
            app.Map("/api/{**path}", () => Results.Json(new { error = "Not found" }, statusCode: 404));
            var frontend = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "frontend");
            if (!Directory.Exists(frontend)) throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Frontend assets not found: {frontend}");
            var files = new PhysicalFileProvider(frontend);
            app.UseDefaultFiles(new DefaultFilesOptions { FileProvider = files });
            app.UseStaticFiles(new StaticFileOptions { FileProvider = files });
            return app;
        }

        private static int PortFromEnvironment()
        {
            var value = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_PORT");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) return 8000;
            if (!int.TryParse(value, out int port) || port is < 1 or > 65535) throw new ArgumentException("GHOSTWIRE_PORT must be between 1 and 65535.");
            return port;
        }
    }
}

                    while (true)
                    {
                        int count = await context.Request.Body.ReadAsync(bytes, context.RequestAborted);
                        if (count == 0) break;
                        if (buffer.Length + count > 16384) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                        buffer.Write(bytes, 0, count);
                    }
                    if (buffer.Length == 0) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                    using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(buffer.ToArray());
                    var request = TrainingService.Validate(document.RootElement);
                    return Results.Json(await service.TestAsync(request, context.RequestAborted));
                }
                catch (JsonException) { return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid JSON" }, statusCode: 400); }
                catch (ArgumentException ex) { return Results.Json(new { error = ex.Message }, statusCode: 400); }
                finally { concurrentTests.Release(); }
            });
            app.Map("/api/{**path}", () => Results.Json(new { error = "Not found" }, statusCode: 404));
            var frontend = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "frontend");
            if (!Directory.Exists(frontend)) throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Frontend assets not found: {frontend}");
            var files = new PhysicalFileProvider(frontend);
            app.UseDefaultFiles(new DefaultFilesOptions { FileProvider = files });
            app.UseStaticFiles(new StaticFileOptions { FileProvider = files });
            return app;
        }

        private static int PortFromEnvironment()
        {
            var value = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_PORT");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) return 8000;
            if (!int.TryParse(value, out int port) || port is < 1 or > 65535) throw new ArgumentException("GHOSTWIRE_PORT must be between 1 and 65535.");
            return port;
        }

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using GhostWire;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting.Server;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting.Server.Features;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new Exception(message); }
static async Task<JsonElement> Post(HttpClient client, object input)
{
    using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/test", input);
    var text = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
    Check(response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.OK, $"test failed: {response.StatusCode} {text}");
    return JsonDocument.Parse(text).RootElement.Clone();
}

Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_AI_BASE_URL", null);
Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_AI_API_KEY", null);
Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_AI_MODEL", null);

// Exercise raw TCP independently of the HTTP client: valid reads, invalid addresses and forbidden writes.
await using (var simulator = new ModbusSimulator(7, new Dictionary<int, Dictionary<int, ushort>> { [3] = new() { [10] = 39 } }))
{
    async Task<byte[]> Exchange(byte[] packet)
    {
        using var tcp = new TcpClient();
        using var deadline = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3));
        await tcp.ConnectAsync(IPAddress.Loopback, simulator.Port, deadline.Token);
        using var stream = tcp.GetStream();
        await stream.WriteAsync(packet, deadline.Token);
        byte[] header = new byte[7];
        await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(header, deadline.Token);
        byte[] body = new byte[(header[4] << 8 | header[5]) - 1];
        await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(body, deadline.Token);
        return body;
    }
    Check((await Exchange(new byte[] { 0,1,0,0,0,6,7,3,0,10,0,1 })).SequenceEqual(new byte[] { 3,2,0,39 }), "FC03 raw response");
    Check((await Exchange(new byte[] { 0,1,0,0,0,6,7,3,0,11,0,1 })).SequenceEqual(new byte[] { 0x83,2 }), "illegal address");
    Check((await Exchange(new byte[] { 0,1,0,0,0,6,7,6,0,10,0,99 })).SequenceEqual(new byte[] { 0x86,1 }), "writes must be rejected");
    Check((await ModbusClient.ReadAsync(simulator.Port, 8, 3, 10, 1, CancellationToken.None)).Status == "timeout", "unit mismatch timeout");
}

await using var app = GhostWireHost.Create(Array.Empty<string>(), 0);
await app.StartAsync();
var address = app.Services.GetRequiredService<IServer>().Features.Get<IServerAddressesFeature>()!.Addresses.Single();
using var client = new HttpClient { BaseAddress = new Uri(address) };
var scenarios = await client.GetFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>("/api/scenarios");
Check(scenarios.GetProperty("scenarios").GetArrayLength() == 3, "three scenarios");
Check((await client.GetAsync("/")).StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.OK, "frontend served");
object P(string id, int unit, int fc, int addr, int qty, double scale) => new { scenario_id = id, unit_id = unit, function_code = fc, address = addr, quantity = qty, scale };
var pressure = await Post(client, P("pressure-scaling",7,3,10,1,1));
Check(pressure.GetProperty("raw_registers")[0].GetInt32() == 39 && !pressure.GetProperty("verified").GetBoolean(), "initial pressure");
pressure = await Post(client, P("pressure-scaling",7,3,10,1,0.01));
Check(pressure.GetProperty("verified").GetBoolean() && Math.Abs(pressure.GetProperty("engineering_value").GetDouble() - 0.39) < 1e-10 && pressure.GetProperty("unit").GetString() == "bar", "pressure correction");
var silent = await Post(client, P("unit-id",1,4,0,1,1));
Check(silent.GetProperty("status").GetString() == "timeout" && !silent.GetProperty("verified").GetBoolean(), "initial timeout");
silent = await Post(client, P("unit-id",17,4,0,1,1));
Check(silent.GetProperty("verified").GetBoolean() && silent.GetProperty("raw_registers")[0].GetInt32() == 73, "unit correction");
var wrong = await Post(client, P("register-addressing",3,4,21,1,1));
Check(wrong.GetProperty("status").GetString() == "exception", "initial exception");
wrong = await Post(client, P("register-addressing",3,4,20,1,1));
Check(wrong.GetProperty("verified").GetBoolean() && wrong.GetProperty("raw_registers")[0].GetInt32() == 125, "address correction");
Check(wrong.GetProperty("explanation_source").GetString() == "deterministic", "fallback without provider");
using (var invalid = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/test", new { scenario_id = "unit-id", unit_id = 17, function_code = 4, address = 0, quantity = 1, scale = 1, host = "example.com" })) Check(invalid.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, "reject unknown target");
using (var invalid = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/test", P("unit-id",17,4,65535,2,1))) Check(invalid.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, "reject overflow");
using (var invalid = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/test", P("unit-id",17,6,0,1,1))) Check(invalid.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, "reject write function");
using (var invalid = await client.PostAsync("/api/test", new StringContent("{\"scenario_id\":\"unit-id\",\"unit_id\":17,\"unit_id\":17,\"function_code\":4,\"address\":0,\"quantity\":1,\"scale\":1}", Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"))) Check(invalid.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, "reject duplicate fields");
using (var invalid = await client.PostAsync("/api/test", new StringContent("{}", Encoding.UTF8, "text/plain"))) Check(invalid.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.UnsupportedMediaType, "reject content type");
using (var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/api/test") { Content = JsonContent.Create(P("unit-id",17,4,0,1,1)) })
{
    request.Headers.Add("Origin", "http://evil.example");
    using var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
    Check(response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, "reject cross-origin");
}
using (var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "/api/scenarios"))
{
    request.Headers.Host = "evil.example";
    using var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
    Check(response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, "reject host");
}
using (var response = await client.PostAsync("/api/test", new StringContent(new string('x', 16385), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"))) Check((int)response.StatusCode is 400 or 413, "reject oversized request");
var providerBuilder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder();
providerBuilder.WebHost.ConfigureKestrel(o => o.Listen(IPAddress.Loopback, 0));
await using var provider = providerBuilder.Build();
bool oversizedProviderResponse = false;
provider.Run(async context =>
{
    Check(context.Request.Path == "/chat/completions", "provider path");
    Check(context.Request.Headers.Authorization == "Bearer test-key", "provider auth");
    if (oversizedProviderResponse) await context.Response.WriteAsync(new string('x', 65537));
    else await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new { choices = new[] { new { message = new { content = "Advisory text" } } } });
});
await provider.StartAsync();
Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_AI_BASE_URL", provider.Services.GetRequiredService<IServer>().Features.Get<IServerAddressesFeature>()!.Addresses.Single());
Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_AI_API_KEY", "test-key");
Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_AI_MODEL", "test-model");
var advisory = await Post(client, P("pressure-scaling",7,3,10,1,0.01));
Check(advisory.GetProperty("explanation_source").GetString() == "openai-compatible" && advisory.GetProperty("raw_registers")[0].GetInt32() == 39, "provider cannot change protocol evidence");
oversizedProviderResponse = true;
advisory = await Post(client, P("pressure-scaling",7,3,10,1,0.01));
Check(advisory.GetProperty("explanation_source").GetString() == "deterministic", "oversized provider fallback");
await provider.StopAsync();
bool rateLimited = false;
for (int i = 0; i < 125; i++)
{
    using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/scenarios");
    if ((int)response.StatusCode == 429) { rateLimited = true; break; }
}
Check(rateLimited, "request rate is bounded");
await app.StopAsync();
Console.WriteLine("All GhostWire protocol and HTTP checks passed.");

<file name="frontend/app.js" language="javascript" >
<content>
'use strict';

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const fields = ['unit_id', 'function_code', 'address', 'quantity', 'scale'];
const categories = [
  ['observations', 'Observations'],
  ['possible_causes', 'Possible causes'],
  ['training_hints', 'Training hints'],
  ['next_steps', 'Next steps'],
];
let scenarios = [];
let history = [];
const caseHistory = new Map();
let running = false;

function text(value, fallback = 'Not returned') {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return fallback;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length ? value.map((item) => text(item)).join(', ') : fallback;
  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
  return String(value);
}
function engineeringValue(result) {
  const value = result.engineering_value;
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'Not returned';
  return `${text(value)}${result.unit ? ` ${text(result.unit)}` : ''}`;
}

function validateScale() {
  const input = $('scale');
  input.setCustomValidity(input.value !== '' && Number(input.value) <= 0 ? 'Scale must be greater than zero.' : '');
}

function verifiedText(value) {
  if (value === true) return 'Verified by this simulated test.';
  if (value === false) return 'Not verified by this simulated test.';
  return text(value, 'No verification result returned.');
}

function sourceText(value) {
  if (value === 'openai-compatible') return 'Source: AI provider';
  if (value === 'deterministic') return 'Source: deterministic fallback';
  return `Source: ${text(value, 'not specified')}`;
}

function fillList(element, values) {
  element.replaceChildren();
  const items = Array.isArray(values) ? values : (values == null ? [] : [values]);
  for (const item of items.length ? items : ['None returned.']) {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.textContent = text(item);
    element.append(li);
  }
}

function addText(parent, tag, value, className) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  node.textContent = value;
  if (className) node.className = className;
  parent.append(node);
  return node;
}

function renderDocumentation(documentation) {
  const container = $('documentation');
  container.replaceChildren();
  const entries = Array.isArray(documentation) ? documentation : [documentation];
  for (const entry of entries) addText(container, 'p', text(entry, 'No documentation returned.'));
}

function selectScenario() {
  const scenario = scenarios.find((item) => item.id === $('scenario').value);
  if (!scenario) return;
  $('scenario-summary').textContent = text(scenario.summary, '');
  renderDocumentation(scenario.documentation);
  $('history-scenario').textContent = `Scenario: ${text(scenario.title)}`;
  history = caseHistory.get(scenario.id) || [];
  const latest = history[history.length - 1];
  for (const field of fields) $(field).value = latest?.request?.[field] ?? scenario.initial[field];
  validateScale();
  if (latest) {
    renderResult(latest);
  } else {
    $('result').hidden = true;
    $('empty-result').hidden = false;
    $('result-status').textContent = 'Awaiting read';
    $('result-status').dataset.state = '';
  }
  $('test-message').dataset.state = '';
  $('test-message').textContent = '';
  $('run-test').textContent = latest ? 'Retest simulated read' : 'Run simulated read';
  renderHistory();
}

async function api(path, options) {
  const response = await fetch(path, options);
  let data;
  try { data = await response.json(); } catch { throw new Error(`Server returned an unreadable response (HTTP ${response.status}).`); }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = data.detail || data.error || data.message;
    throw new Error(detail ? text(detail) : `Request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
  }
  return data;
}

async function loadScenarios() {
  $('load-message').hidden = false;
  $('load-message').textContent = 'Loading scenarios…';
  $('load-message').dataset.state = '';
  $('retry-load').hidden = true;
  $('setup-content').hidden = true;
  try {
    const data = await api('/api/scenarios');
    if (!Array.isArray(data.scenarios) || !data.scenarios.length) throw new Error('No scenarios were returned.');
    scenarios = data.scenarios;
    $('scenario').replaceChildren();
    for (const scenario of scenarios) {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = scenario.id;
      option.textContent = scenario.title;
      $('scenario').append(option);
    }
    selectScenario();
    $('setup-content').hidden = false;
    $('load-message').hidden = true;
  } catch (error) {
    $('load-message').textContent = `Could not load scenarios: ${error.message}`;
    $('load-message').dataset.state = 'error';
    $('retry-load').hidden = false;
  }
}

function renderResult(result) {
  $('empty-result').hidden = true;
  $('result').hidden = false;
  $('result-status').textContent = `Status: ${text(result.status, 'unknown')}`;
  $('result-status').dataset.state = result.status === 'response' ? 'success' : (result.status === 'exception' || result.status === 'error' ? 'error' : '');
  $('engineering-value').textContent = engineeringValue(result);
  $('raw-registers').textContent = text(result.raw_registers);
  for (const [key] of categories) fillList($(key), result[key]);
  $('verified').textContent = verifiedText(result.verified);
  $('verified').parentElement.dataset.state = result.verified === true ? 'success' : '';
  $('explanation').textContent = text(result.explanation, 'No explanation returned.');
  $('explanation-source').textContent = sourceText(result.explanation_source);
}
function renderComparison() {
  const container = $('comparison-results');
  container.replaceChildren();
  const hasComparison = history.length >= 2;
  $('comparison-empty').hidden = hasComparison;
  container.hidden = !hasComparison;
  if (!hasComparison) return;

  const previous = history[history.length - 2];
  const current = history[history.length - 1];
  for (const [label, entry, number] of [
    ['Previous', previous, history.length - 1],
    ['Current', current, history.length],
  ]) {
    const section = document.createElement('section');
    section.className = 'comparison-read';
    addText(section, 'h3', `${label} · read ${number}`);
    const request = entry.request || {};
    addText(section, 'p', `Request: unit ${text(request.unit_id)}, function ${text(request.function_code)}, address ${text(request.address)}, quantity ${text(request.quantity)}, scale ${text(request.scale)}.`);
    addText(section, 'p', `Status: ${text(entry.status, 'unknown')}. Raw registers: ${text(entry.raw_registers)}. Engineering value: ${engineeringValue(entry)} (simulated).`);
    addText(section, 'p', verifiedText(entry.verified));
    container.append(section);
  }
  const changed = fields.filter((field) => previous.request?.[field] !== current.request?.[field]);
  const labels = { unit_id: 'Unit ID', function_code: 'Function code', address: 'Address', quantity: 'Quantity', scale: 'Scale' };
  addText(container, 'p', changed.length
    ? `Changed settings: ${changed.map((field) => `${labels[field]} (${text(previous.request?.[field])} to ${text(current.request?.[field])})`).join(', ')}.`
    : 'No request settings changed between these reads.', 'comparison-changes');
}


function renderHistory() {
  const list = $('history-list');
  list.replaceChildren();
  $('history-empty').hidden = history.length > 0;
  $('print-report').disabled = history.length === 0;
  renderComparison();
  history.forEach((entry, index) => {
    const item = document.createElement('li');
    const details = document.createElement('details');
    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
    summary.textContent = `Read ${index + 1} · ${text(entry.status, 'unknown')} · ${verifiedText(entry.verified)}`;
    details.append(summary);
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'history-detail';
    const request = entry.request || {};
    addText(body, 'p', `Request: unit ${text(request.unit_id)}, function ${text(request.function_code)}, address ${text(request.address)}, quantity ${text(request.quantity)}, scale ${text(request.scale)}.`);
    addText(body, 'p', `Raw registers: ${text(entry.raw_registers)}. Engineering value: ${engineeringValue(entry)} (simulated).`);
    for (const [key, label] of categories) {
      addText(body, 'h3', label);
      const ul = document.createElement('ul');
      fillList(ul, entry[key]);
      body.append(ul);
    }
    addText(body, 'h3', `Explanation · ${sourceText(entry.explanation_source)}`);
    addText(body, 'p', text(entry.explanation, 'No explanation returned.'));
    details.append(body);
    item.append(details);
    list.append(item);
  });
}

let expandedBeforePrint = [];
window.addEventListener('beforeprint', () => {
  expandedBeforePrint = Array.from($('history-list').querySelectorAll('details')).map((details) => details.open);
  $('history-list').querySelectorAll('details').forEach ( (details) => { details.open = true; });
});
window.addEventListener('afterprint', () => {
  $('history-list').querySelectorAll('details').forEach((details, index) => { details.open = expandedBeforePrint[index] || false; });
});

$('scenario').addEventListener('change', selectScenario);
$('scale').addEventListener('input', validateScale);
$('retry-load').addEventListener('click', loadScenarios);
$('print-report').addEventListener('click', () => window.print());
$('test-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (running) return;
  validateScale();
  if (!$('test-form').reportValidity()) return;
  const request = { scenario_id: $('scenario').value };
  for (const field of fields) request[field] = Number($(field).value);
  running = true;
  $('scenario').disabled = true;
  $('request-fields').disabled = true;
  $('run-test').disabled = true;
  $('test-message').textContent = 'Reading the local simulator…';
  $('test-message').dataset.state = '';
  try {
    const result = await api('/api/test', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(request) });
    if (!result.request) result.request = request;
    history.push(result);
    caseHistory.set(request.scenario_id, history);
    renderResult(result);
    renderHistory();
    $('run-test').textContent = 'Retest simulated read';
    $('test-message').textContent = 'Read complete. Adjust a setting and retest to compare results.';
  } catch (error) {
    $('test-message').textContent = `Read failed: ${error.message} Check the request and try again.`;
    $('test-message').dataset.state = 'error';
  } finally {
    running = false;
    $('scenario').disabled = false;
    $('request-fields').disabled = false;
    $('run-test').disabled = false;
  }
});

loadScenarios();

</content>

<file name="frontend/app.js" language="javascript" >
<content>
'use strict';

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const fields = ['unit_id', 'function_code', 'address', 'quantity', 'scale'];
const categories = [
  ['observations', 'Observations'],
  ['possible_causes', 'Possible causes'],
  ['training_hints', 'Training hints'],
  ['next_steps', 'Next steps'],
];
let scenarios = [];
let history = [];
const caseHistory = new Map();
let running = false;

function text(value, fallback = 'Not returned') {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return fallback;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length ? value.map((item) => text(item)).join(', ') : fallback;
  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
  return String(value);
}
function engineeringValue(result) {
  const value = result.engineering_value;
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'Not returned';
  return `${text(value)}${result.unit ? ` ${text(result.unit)}` : ''}`;
}

function validateScale() {
  const input = $('scale');
  input.setCustomValidity(input.value !== '' && Number(input.value) <= 0 ? 'Scale must be greater than zero.' : '');
}

function verifiedText(value) {
  if (value === true) return 'Verified by this simulated test.';
  if (value === false) return 'Not verified by this simulated test.';
  return text(value, 'No verification result returned.');
}

function sourceText(value) {
  if (value === 'openai-compatible') return 'Source: AI provider';
  if (value === 'deterministic') return 'Source: deterministic fallback';
  return `Source: ${text(value, 'not specified')}`;
}

function fillList(element, values) {
  element.replaceChildren();
  const items = Array.isArray(values) ? values : (values == null ? [] : [values]);
  for (const item of items.length ? items : ['None returned.']) {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.textContent = text(item);
    element.append(li);
  }
}

function addText(parent, tag, value, className) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  node.textContent = value;
  if (className) node.className = className;
  parent.append(node);
  return node;
}

function renderDocumentation(documentation) {
  const container = $('documentation');
  container.replaceChildren();
  const entries = Array.isArray(documentation) ? documentation : [documentation];
  for (const entry of entries) addText(container, 'p', text(entry, 'No documentation returned.'));
}

function selectScenario() {
  const scenario = scenarios.find((item) => item.id === $('scenario').value);
  if (!scenario) return;
  $('scenario-summary').textContent = text(scenario.summary, '');
  renderDocumentation(scenario.documentation);
  $('history-scenario').textContent = `Scenario: ${text(scenario.title)}`;
  history = caseHistory.get(scenario.id) || [];
  const latest = history[history.length - 1];
  for (const field of fields) $(field).value = latest?.request?.[field] ?? scenario.initial[field];
  validateScale();
  if (latest) {
    renderResult(latest);
  } else {
    $('result').hidden = true;
    $('empty-result').hidden = false;
    $('result-status').textContent = 'Awaiting read';
    $('result-status').dataset.state = '';
  }
  $('test-message').dataset.state = '';
  $('test-message').textContent = '';
  $('run-test').textContent = latest ? 'Retest simulated read' : 'Run simulated read';
  renderHistory();
}

async function api(path, options) {
  const response = await fetch(path, options);
  let data;
  try { data = await response.json(); } catch { throw new Error(`Server returned an unreadable response (HTTP ${response.status}).`); }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = data.detail || data.error || data.message;
    throw new Error(detail ? text(detail) : `Request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
  }
  return data;
}

async function loadScenarios() {
  $('load-message').hidden = false;
  $('load-message').textContent = 'Loading scenarios…';
  $('load-message').dataset.state = '';
  $('retry-load').hidden = true;
  $('setup-content').hidden = true;
  try {
    const data = await api('/api/scenarios');
    if (!Array.isArray(data.scenarios) || !data.scenarios.length) throw new Error('No scenarios were returned.');
    scenarios = data.scenarios;
    $('scenario').replaceChildren();
    for (const scenario of scenarios) {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = scenario.id;
      option.textContent = scenario.title;
      $('scenario').append(option);
    }
    selectScenario();
    $('setup-content').hidden = false;
    $('load-message').hidden = true;
  } catch (error) {
    $('load-message').textContent = `Could not load scenarios: ${error.message}`;
    $('load-message').dataset.state = 'error';
    $('retry-load').hidden = false;
  }
}

function renderResult(result) {
  $('empty-result').hidden = true;
  $('result').hidden = false;
  $('result-status').textContent = `Status: ${text(result.status, 'unknown')}`;
  $('result-status').dataset.state = result.status === 'response' ? 'success' : (result.status === 'exception' || result.status === 'error' ? 'error' : '');
  $('engineering-value').textContent = engineeringValue(result);
  $('raw-registers').textContent = text(result.raw_registers);
  for (const [key] of categories) fillList($(key), result[key]);
  $('verified').textContent = verifiedText(result.verified);
  $('verified').parentElement.dataset.state = result.verified === true ? 'success' : '';
  $('explanation').textContent = text(result.explanation, 'No explanation returned.');
  $('explanation-source').textContent = sourceText(result.explanation_source);
}
function renderComparison() {
  const container = $('comparison-results');
  container.replaceChildren();
  const hasComparison = history.length >= 2;
  $('comparison-empty').hidden = hasComparison;
  container.hidden = !hasComparison;
  if (!hasComparison) return;

  const previous = history[history.length - 2];
  const current = history[history.length - 1];
  for (const [label, entry, number] of [
    ['Previous', previous, history.length - 1],
    ['Current', current, history.length],
  ]) {
    const section = document.createElement('section');
    section.className = 'comparison-read';
    addText(section, 'h3', `${label} · read ${number}`);
    const request = entry.request || {};
    addText(section, 'p', `Request: unit ${text(request.unit_id)}, function ${text(request.function_code)}, address ${text(request.address)}, quantity ${text(request.quantity)}, scale ${text(request.scale)}.`);
    addText(section, 'p', `Status: ${text(entry.status, 'unknown')}. Raw registers: ${text(entry.raw_registers)}. Engineering value: ${engineeringValue(entry)} (simulated).`);
    addText(section, 'p', verifiedText(entry.verified));
    container.append(section);
  }
  const changed = fields.filter((field) => previous.request?.[field] !== current.request?.[field]);
  const labels = { unit_id: 'Unit ID', function_code: 'Function code', address: 'Address', quantity: 'Quantity', scale: 'Scale' };
  addText(container, 'p', changed.length
    ? `Changed settings: ${changed.map((field) => `${labels[field]} (${text(previous.request?.[field])} to ${text(current.request?.[field])})`).join(', ')}.`
    : 'No request settings changed between these reads.', 'comparison-changes');
}


function renderHistory() {
  const list = $('history-list');
  list.replaceChildren();
  $('history-empty').hidden = history.length > 0;
  $('print-report').disabled = history.length === 0;
  renderComparison();
  history.forEach((entry, index) => {
    const item = document.createElement('li');
    const details = document.createElement('details');
    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
    summary.textContent = `Read ${index + 1} · ${text(entry.status, 'unknown')} · ${verifiedText(entry.verified)}`;
    details.append(summary);
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'history-detail';
    const request = entry.request || {};
    addText(body, 'p', `Request: unit ${text(request.unit_id)}, function ${text(request.function_code)}, address ${text(request.address)}, quantity ${text(request.quantity)}, scale ${text(request.scale)}.`);
    addText(body, 'p', `Raw registers: ${text(entry.raw_registers)}. Engineering value: ${engineeringValue(entry)} (simulated).`);
    for (const [key, label] of categories) {
      addText(body, 'h3', label);
      const ul = document.createElement('ul');
      fillList(ul, entry[key]);
      body.append(ul);
    }
    addText(body, 'h3', `Explanation · ${sourceText(entry.explanation_source)}`);
    addText(body, 'p', text(entry.explanation, 'No explanation returned.'));
    details.append(body);
    item.append(details);
    list.append(item);
  });
}

let expandedBeforePrint = [];
window.addEventListener('beforeprint', () => {
  expandedBeforePrint = Array.from($('history-list').querySelectorAll('details')).map((details) => details.open);
  $('history-list').querySelectorAll('details').forEach ( (details) => { details.open = true; });
});
window.addEventListener('afterprint', () => {
  $('history-list').querySelectorAll('details').forEach((details, index) => { details.open = expandedBeforePrint[index] || false; });
});

$('scenario').addEventListener('change', selectScenario);
$('scale').addEventListener('input', validateScale);
$('retry-load').addEventListener('click', loadScenarios);
$('print-report').addEventListener('click', () => window.print());
$('test-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (running) return;
  validateScale();
  if (!$('test-form').reportValidity()) return;
  const request = { scenario_id: $('scenario').value };
  for (const field of fields) request[field] = Number($(field).value);
  running = true;
  $('scenario').disabled = true;
  $('request-fields').disabled = true;
  $('run-test').disabled = true;
  $('test-message').textContent = 'Reading the local simulator…';
  $('test-message').dataset.state = '';
  try {
    const result = await api('/api/test', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(request) });
    if (!result.request) result.request = request;
    history.push(result);
    caseHistory.set(request.scenario_id, history);
    renderResult(result);
    renderHistory();
    $('run-test').textContent = 'Retest simulated read';
    $('test-message').textContent = 'Read complete. Adjust a setting and retest to compare results.';
  } catch (error) {
    $('test-message').textContent = `Read failed: ${error.message} Check the request and try again.`;
    $('test-message').dataset.state = 'error';
  } finally {
    running = false;
    $('scenario').disabled = false;
    $('request-fields').disabled = false;
    $('run-test').disabled = false;
  }
});

loadScenarios();

</content>

<file name="frontend/styles.css" language="plaintext" >
<content>
:root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --ink: #f2eee6;
  --muted: #c2c3bb;
  --paper: #111516;
  --surface: #202526;
  --line: #6d7976;
  --forest: #ffad69;
  --forest-dark: #11191a;
  --accent: #ffad69;
  --soft: #303839;
  --focus: #ffbc80;
  --success: #92e2a9;
  --error: #ffacaa;
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--paper);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
body { margin: 0; }
button, input, select { font: inherit; }
button, select, summary { cursor: pointer; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: 1rem; top: -5rem; z-index: 10; padding: .75rem 1rem; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); }
.skip-link:focus { top: 1rem; }
.masthead { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: .75rem 1.5rem; padding: 1rem clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem); color: white; background: var(--forest-dark); }
.brand { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
.brand span { font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--muted); }
.safety-label { font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.safety-label span, footer span { padding: 0 .3rem; }
.page { max-width: 100rem; margin: auto; padding: 2rem 1rem 4rem; }
.intro { display: grid; gap: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.eyebrow { margin: 0 0 .5rem; color: var(--forest); font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em; }
h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }
h1 { margin-bottom: .5rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 750; font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4.5vw, 4.25rem); line-height: 1.06; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
h2 { margin-bottom: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
h3 { margin-bottom: .5rem; font-size: .95rem; }
.lede { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 0; max-width: 40rem; }
.scope-note { margin: 0; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); }
.scope-note strong { color: var(--ink); }
.workflow { margin: 0 0 1.5rem; border-block: 1px solid var(--line); }
.workflow ol { display: grid; gap: .75rem; margin: 0; padding: 1rem 0; list-style: none; counter-reset: workflow; }
.workflow li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr; column-gap: .5rem; padding: 0; counter-increment: workflow; }
.workflow li + li { margin: 0; }
.workflow li::before { grid-row: span 2; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 800; content: counter(workflow, decimal-leading-zero); }
.workflow strong { line-height: 1.3; }
.workflow span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; }
.layout { display: grid; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.results-column { display: grid; gap: 1rem; min-width: 0; }
.panel { min-width: 0; padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.section-heading { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .75rem 1rem; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.muted { color: var(--muted); font-size: .875rem; }
label, legend { display: block; color: var(--ink); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: .4rem; }
select, input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid #a0aaa4; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); padding: .55rem .65rem; }
.scenario-summary { color: var(--muted); font-size: .875rem; margin: .65rem 0 1.25rem; }
.documentation { background: var(--soft); padding: .75rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
summary { min-height: 2.75rem; font-weight: 700; padding: .65rem 0; }
.doc-content { color: var(--ink); font-size: .875rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.doc-content p:last-child { margin-bottom: .25rem; }
fieldset { border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; min-width: 0; }
legend { padding: 0; margin-bottom: .85rem; font-size: 1rem; }
.fields { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
.field-help { color: var(--muted); margin: .4rem 0 0; font-size: .8rem; }
button { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .7rem 1rem; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 2px; }
button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .6; }
.primary { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--accent); color: #1c120b; background: var(--accent); }
.primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ffd1a8; }
.secondary { border: 1px solid var(--forest); color: var(--forest); background: transparent; }
.secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--soft); }
.form-message, .notice { font-size: .875rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.form-message:not(:empty) { margin: .75rem 0 0; }
.notice { padding: .75rem; background: var(--soft); margin-bottom: .75rem; }
.status, .source { color: var(--forest); background: var(--soft); padding: .35rem .6rem; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.status[data-state="success"], .verification[data-state="success"] .reading-label { color: var(--success); }
.status[data-state="error"], .form-message[data-state="error"], .notice[data-state="error"] { color: var(--error); }
.empty-state { border: 1px dashed var(--line); padding: 2.5rem 1rem; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); }
.empty-state strong { color: var(--ink); }
.empty-state p { margin: .4rem auto 0; max-width: 28rem; }
.reading { display: grid; gap: 1.25rem; padding: 1.25rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--forest-dark); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.reading-label { display: block; font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.reading strong { display: block; font-size: clamp(1.65rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); line-height: 1.2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.reading-caption { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--muted); }
.raw-reading strong { margin-top: .4rem; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.evidence-grid { display: grid; gap: 1.25rem; margin: 1.5rem 0; }
.evidence-grid section { min-width: 0; }
.evidence-grid h3 span { display: block; margin-top: .2rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 500; }
ul { padding-left: 1.2rem; margin: 0; }
li { padding-left: .1rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
li + li { margin-top: .4rem; }
.evidence-grid ul, .history-detail { font-size: .875rem; }
.verification { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 1rem 0; }
.verification .reading-label { color: var(--forest); }
.verification p { margin: .35rem 0 0; }
.explanation { background: var(--paper); padding: 1rem; }
.explanation-heading { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; }
.explanation p { margin: .5rem 0 0; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
